explication: EMBA is a command-line firmware security analyzer and SBOM tool. A user supplies firmware and a scan profile; the documented analysis covers extraction, static and optional emulation-based dynamic analysis, SBOM generation, and a web-based vulnerability report. The tree identifies dedicated system-emulation and SBOM module directories, but no source excerpts were provided, so relationships below rely on README workflow descriptions rather than implementation-level calls.
